notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around standard time-regulation and time-constrained enablement callbacks. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. It verifies suppression and release of time-role enablement callbacks, exact initial-time metadata, callback-model servicing, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with enableTimeRegulation/enableTimeConstrained and FederateAmbassador timeRegulationEnabled/timeConstrainedEnabled delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador callback-control and time-role declarations
